description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTrackerLogsController class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for the Performance plugin. The class handles rendering employee performance tracker logs and access control logic related to performance tracking data.

classes.name: EmployeeTrackerLogsController
classes.description: Controller managing employee performance tracker logs, rendering components, and handling access control within the OrangeHRM performance plugin.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets the performance tracker logs component with relevant data such as tracker ID and employee number.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Determines if the current user has permission to view the specified performance tracker, throwing an exception if access is denied.
